issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Former Minneapolis Mayoral Aide and Safari Restaurant Co-Owner Both Plead Guilty in $250 Million Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
supports: Abdulkadir Nur Salah and Abdi Nur Salah pleaded guilty on January 28, 2025.
The plea release identifies cash already seized from specified accounts and says the defendants agreed those assets and money were derived from the fraud scheme and subject to forfeiture.
does_not_support: The release does not establish that seized cash was finally forfeited or recovered by the government.
Real property identified as subject to forfeiture is not assigned a dollar value in the release.
